./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3993:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3994:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4075:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4076:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4078:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:7402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:14:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4233:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4244:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1781:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:18:问: 用这些 ON-DISK 数据, **单个最可能成的 CCF-B 方法稿方向**是什么? 重点考虑团队没碰过的 **RSTPReid text-to-image** 这条新模态(team 有强 image backbone 可当 visual encoder), 也可考虑跨域(market→occluded_reid)/多数据集泛化/新协议/训练侧创新。要给: 触发观察(在哪能找到一个具体失败) + 重定义 + 机制 + **廉价(最好零训练 frozen-feature)kill-switch** + 撞车核查(text-image ReID 很卷, IRRA/APTM/RDE/CADA 等)。**诚实: 若 text-image 也卷死、其他也都死路, 直说该把 Hubness 写 analysis short 收尾、别再撞。** 联网, 务实中文, verdict + 信心 1-10。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4654:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21572:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3181:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4234:reassess/r_2.md:1241:reassess/r_3.md:2779:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:45:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4692:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21610:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5101:reassess/r_3.md:3209:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4519:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5297:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5426:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:68:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:104:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5577:   - backbone injection 明确优于 post-hoc pooling
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5644:- **结论**: 让 backbone 在特征提取过程中知道人体结构，比事后选择更有效
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5658:**4. PSG 跨数据集/backbone 均有效（4090 验证）**
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5735:- **风险**: 前 21 个实验显示 post-backbone 方法收益有限，但 GCN 提供了全新的结构推理能力
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5752:- **优势**: 零推理开销，改变 backbone 的内在表征
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5820:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5874:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1038:experiments/exp356r_pcmsc_random/design.md:4:20-codex #3, 机制上离今晚所有失败最远: **不"融合"、是"补全"**。pose mask 掉**可见**部位的 backbone token, 让模型从可见证据**重建**那块的 CLIP 语义——被删的 token 吸不走(从输入删了), 是 CLIP(单图全局)和 LGPA(部位判别)都没有的补全能力。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5947:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5738:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot(4090/3090/5060Ti×2)无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=新人体自监督预训练 pretext**(从 SOLIDER/DINOv2 权重 continued-pretraining 新 pretext task, person 数据, 非 from-scratch 省算力)。问: (a)SOLIDER(2023 semantic-controllable SSL on LUPerson)之后, person-specific SSL 预训练新 pretext 还有什么空间(occlusion-aware completion pretext? cross-view correspondence? part-whole consistency? identity-preserving masked-modeling? 多粒度?)? (b)我 4-slot 从 SOLIDER/DINOv2 continued-pretrain(中等算力 market+msmt+occluded 数据)能 build 的最有野心新 pretext(loss/data/规模)? ./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6267:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:1752:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_dualbranch.md:17:#3 oracle 验证: 软融合 AIRL+baseline 距离 → mean +1.46(合法 w=0.25)。双分支 = 1 backbone + 2 BNNeck head 内化这个融合: **f_full**(原 head,ID-CE+shared triplet,无 consistency,保 G→A)+ **f_rec**(新 BNNeck,自己 ID-CE + AIRL consistency,服务低清 A→G)。eval 软融合两 head cosine。framing 钉死"observation-limited evidence ceiling + 按 query 像素预算路由证据空间"(避 resolution-adaptive dual-branch 撞车)。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6592:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4495:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6809:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:1752:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_dualbranch.md:17:#3 oracle 验证: 软融合 AIRL+baseline 距离 → mean +1.46(合法 w=0.25)。双分支 = 1 backbone + 2 BNNeck head 内化这个融合: **f_full**(原 head,ID-CE+shared triplet,无 consistency,保 G→A)+ **f_rec**(新 BNNeck,自己 ID-CE + AIRL consistency,服务低清 A→G)。eval 软融合两 head cosine。framing 钉死"observation-limited evidence ceiling + 按 query 像素预算路由证据空间"(避 resolution-adaptive dual-branch 撞车)。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7554:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5432:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7559:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5738:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot(4090/3090/5060Ti×2)无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=新人体自监督预训练 pretext**(从 SOLIDER/DINOv2 权重 continued-pretraining 新 pretext task, person 数据, 非 from-scratch 省算力)。问: (a)SOLIDER(2023 semantic-controllable SSL on LUPerson)之后, person-specific SSL 预训练新 pretext 还有什么空间(occlusion-aware completion pretext? cross-view correspondence? part-whole consistency? identity-preserving masked-modeling? 多粒度?)? (b)我 4-slot 从 SOLIDER/DINOv2 continued-pretrain(中等算力 market+msmt+occluded 数据)能 build 的最有野心新 pretext(loss/data/规模)? (c)避开 SOLIDER/LUPerson/MAE-ReID/各种 SSL-ReID, 联网查 2024-26 novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量+风险+B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7561:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5781:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot 无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=自由(新监督信号/跨界 import/新训练目标)**。避死区: CLIP-ReID(language 占)/SMPL 几何(我项目多次证负无独特 ReID 信号)/FM-import MLLM-DINO-SD(我项目证负 判别性-互补性张力)/test-time trick。问: 2026 ReID 训练端哪个范式级方向(新监督信号如 video-temporal/attribute/synthetic-label, 或跨界 import 如 face-recognition/3D/retrieval-pretraining 训练范式, 或新训练目标)最有野心 × 4-slot 单卡周级可行 × 真 novelty × 能 actually build? 给 3 候选排序。**不判死, 选去 build + pipeline + 工作量 + 风险 + B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7563:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6237:→ **转 fallback: Swin-VI 机制**。VI-ReID 至今 ResNet50 主导、无 Swin/CLIP 赢家(纯 ViT PMT 才 67.5 R1), 团队是 Swin/SOLIDER 专家。CAJ ResNet baseline 已搭好(POOL 76.80/69.14)→ 换 Swin-Small(SOLIDER pretrain)→ 强 backbone 在 VI-ReID 帮不帮? 帮=机制论文; 不帮=为什么不帮(模态 gap 吞掉 backbone 红利)也是机制问题。先做这个经验首验。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:17:**★非对称 LSRC 已实测（2026-06-26 用户二次质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, --lsrc_asym query-set × gallery-single, lam0.5, 40ep）= 死 −0.33**（h16 lattice MaxSim 79.57 vs no-LM 79.90, 没过 +0.3 线; HR sanity 87.63 −1.29; single 77.29 −0.15; h24 lattice 84.73 d+0.893）。**但比对称温和太多**（−0.33 vs 对称 −1.92）: 我之前"对称死→非对称必死"**结论对但严重低估温和度**——外推只给死/活, 实测才知非对称几乎不伤 single(−0.15)、lattice 仅 −0.33（差点到 0 但仍 net negative）。机理证实 backbone set-loss 损害判别力对称/非对称都有, 非对称(不给 gallery oracle)温和但回不到正。**→ 非对称 LSRC 从"推理判死"升级"实测死"，至此 LM-ReID 训练端 100% 实测穷尽零外推**（frozen LS-MRT/LATS + backbone-loss consistency/LSRC对称/LSRC非对称 + robust-ERM Hard-Lattice + input BLC证伪）。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60:| LCRS（互补 residual） | 7/10 | `z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + α·P_k(g_k))`，shared identity core + lattice-specific residual subspace + decorr(只在分类正确后)。"准确后分工"非硬推开。test K=9 边缘化拿更富 union | 冻 backbone 训 P_shared/P_k/cls；活=K-error correlation 降+K=9 gain ≥+0.5，individual variant mAP 不掉>0.8 | 排队 |

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:62:| LC-STN（对齐 canonicalize） | 7/10 | tiny localization net 预测 bbox offset(dx,dy)+grid_sample 重采样到 canonical, L_geo=SmoothL1 监督几何非身份, 残差留 marginalization | 冻 backbone 训 canonicalizer；活=offset MAE<0.35 LR px + K=1 +0.8 OR K=9 +0.3 | 排队 |

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1533:experiments/exp340b_fixedbands_undetach/claude_review.md:53:- 关键：FIXED_BANDS 的 GT 是**对所有图相同的固定竖直 band 布局**（与图像内容/真实姿态无关）。于是该项在 w=0.5 + 全量 backbone 梯度下，逼 backbone 产出「CLIP 跨注意力匹配固定 canonical 分块」的空间特征——在遮挡数据上（真实部位常缺失/位移），可能逼 backbone 幻想出与实际遮挡内容矛盾的 canonical 结构，**有损判别性**。这是本变体最大的科学风险，design.md 仅泛泛写「un-detach 扰动/退化」，未点名这条「固定先验正则化 backbone」的具体路径。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:4714:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19979:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3108:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4159:reassess/r_2.md:1002:reassess/r_3.md:1961:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:4851:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21559:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3108:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4159:reassess/r_2.md:1002:reassess/r_3.md:1961:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5353:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5432:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5446:- ✅ 仍守：动手前查 novelty（避先例）、full fine-tune/backbone 训练前 codex 审 diff、文档先行、诚实报告
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5475:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6603:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6626:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:15:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? ./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6694:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:550:**执行结果**: exp003 在 ep60 终止，mAP 50.2%（-6.4% vs baseline）。降低 global loss weight 严重伤害 backbone 特征质量。Part 分类器虽学得更快（id_part 2.08 vs exp001 ~3.3），但池化的 backbone 特征变差了。**结论：global 和 part 是共生关系，不能通过削弱 global 来强化 part。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6701:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:664:**执行结果**: exp008 mAP 57.7%, R1 66.0%。**组合不叠加**，低于 PSG-only (58.3%/67.9%)。Part pooling 的 part_only 测试模式丢弃了 PSG 增强的 global feature，而 part features 本身无法匹配 PSG-global 的质量。**结论：backbone-level injection 是更有效的 pose 利用方式，post-hoc pooling 在 PSG 基础上没有增量价值。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6715:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:769:- **结论**: 让 backbone 在特征提取过程中知道人体结构，比事后选择更有效
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6737:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1096:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6738:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1099:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:149:"mechanism": "Occlusion is reframed as a structured, invertible distortion in feature space rather than something the backbone must learn to tolerate: clean ViT features F are corrupted into occluded features F_o by an unknown transform T, and a Latent Diffusion-guided De-Occluder (DDO) learns T^-1. DDO projects occluded ViT features (768x14x14) into a 256-channel latent, runs a conditional reverse-diffusion denoiser supervised by paired clean features (a reconstruction loss L_recon = lambda*MSE + (1-lambda)*(1-cos) added to the standard denoising loss acts like classifier guidance), and decodes a reconstructed clean embedding F_clean. F_clean and F_o are then fused via multi-head cross-attention (Q from F_clean, K/V from F_o), part-pooled with a Global-Enhanced Local Token (GELT) fusion, and trained with a modified centroid triplet loss plus per-part cross-entropy. A separate Hybrid Re-Ranking (HRR) stage exploits the closed-set assumption: it computes per-identity gallery centroids, keeps only the Top-N centroids closest to the query, and runs k-reciprocal Jaccard re-ranking restricted to that centroid-pruned candidate subset.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6740:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6764:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7359:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7360:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3334:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:14:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot 无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=自由(新监督信号/跨界 import/新训练目标)**。避死区: CLIP-ReID(language 占)/SMPL 几何(我项目多次证负无独特 ReID 信号)/FM-import MLLM-DINO-SD(我项目证负 判别性-互补性张力)/test-time trick。问: 2026 ReID 训练端哪个范式级方向(新监督信号如 video-temporal/attribute/synthetic-label, 或跨界 import 如 face-recognition/3D/retrieval-pretraining 训练范式, 或新训练目标)最有野心 × 4-slot 单卡周级可行 × 真 novelty × 能 actually build? 给 3 候选排序。**不判死, 选去 build + pipeline + 工作量 + 风险 + B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7361:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3338:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:15:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7488:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:320:- **结论**: 让 backbone 在特征提取过程中知道人体结构，比事后选择更有效
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7549:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:813:**执行结果**: exp003 在 ep60 终止，mAP 50.2%（-6.4% vs baseline）。降低 global loss weight 严重伤害 backbone 特征质量。Part 分类器虽学得更快（id_part 2.08 vs exp001 ~3.3），但池化的 backbone 特征变差了。**结论：global 和 part 是共生关系，不能通过削弱 global 来强化 part。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7556:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:927:**执行结果**: exp008 mAP 57.7%, R1 66.0%。**组合不叠加**，低于 PSG-only (58.3%/67.9%)。Part pooling 的 part_only 测试模式丢弃了 PSG 增强的 global feature，而 part features 本身无法匹配 PSG-global 的质量。**结论：backbone-level injection 是更有效的 pose 利用方式，post-hoc pooling 在 PSG 基础上没有增量价值。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7590:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1395:experiments/exp343_pose_guided_clip/design.md:29:**结论**: pose_guided_pool 有自己的 query/k_proj,把 i2t/t2i 对齐**吸收进自己的 pathway**,backbone/global 没拿到 exp341 那种直接对齐信号 → 抵消了 exp341 的 +2.2,退回 baseline。**Option A 失败:姿态这样融(换对齐的特征)反而去掉了 CLIP 机制的增益。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7591:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1437:experiments/overnight_pose_clip_search.md:62:**纠正结论: exp342b 的 +0.9 大部分是 pose(un-detach LGPA, 用户自己的机制), CLIP 只 +0.2 边际/冗余。无真正 CLIP+pose 协同。CLIP 给强pose系统加东西加不动(冗余), 与白天"强backbone上互补信号被吃掉"一致。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7596:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1478:experiments/exp347_noparam_deocc/claude_review.md:72:**审查通过**。PoseWeightedPool 经 AST 校验确认真无参数；梯度路径 `clip_id_loss → clip_id_proj → 无参数池化 → featmaps[-1] → backbone` 完整无 detach，构成 Option A 吸收陷阱的有效修复；对齐目标为纯 ID 原型（pose_cond=False，无姿态污染，隔离 Option B 失败模式）；描述子为 raw GAP global、池化严格 train-only；AMP 混合 dtype einsum 有 exp343/Option A 同模式跑通先例；与 exp341 的唯一功能变量为 `POSE_CLIP_ID_NOPARAM_POOL`（`POSE_TEST_FEAT` 差异已证描述子等价，非第二变量）。无 Critical/High/Medium 问题，2 项 Low 均为澄清性、无需修复。可进入 Codex 审查。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7872:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:4714:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19979:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3108:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4159:reassess/r_2.md:1002:reassess/r_3.md:1961:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:7980:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:4851:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21559:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3108:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4159:reassess/r_2.md:1002:reassess/r_3.md:1961:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:8089:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:5432:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4495:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1096:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1099:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:149:"mechanism": "Occlusion is reframed as a structured, invertible distortion in feature space rather than something the backbone must learn to tolerate: clean ViT features F are corrupted into occluded features F_o by an unknown transform T, and a Latent Diffusion-guided De-Occluder (DDO) learns T^-1. DDO projects occluded ViT features (768x14x14) into a 256-channel latent, runs a conditional reverse-diffusion denoiser supervised by paired clean features (a reconstruction loss L_recon = lambda*MSE + (1-lambda)*(1-cos) added to the standard denoising loss acts like classifier guidance), and decodes a reconstructed clean embedding F_clean. F_clean and F_o are then fused via multi-head cross-attention (Q from F_clean, K/V from F_o), part-pooled with a Global-Enhanced Local Token (GELT) fusion, and trained with a modified centroid triplet loss plus per-part cross-entropy. A separate Hybrid Re-Ranking (HRR) stage exploits the closed-set assumption: it computes per-identity gallery centroids, keeps only the Top-N centroids closest to the query, and runs k-reciprocal Jaccard re-ranking restricted to that centroid-pruned candidate subset.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1117:experiments/exp093/review.md:14:| 1 | HIGH | design.md vs pose_backbone_model.py | 设计把 PGTM 叙述成“在 Stage 3 内部把 48 个 spatial token 合成 5 个 body-part token 再做 attention”；实际实现是在原始 Swin block 之后额外加一个 merge-attend-expand 残差模块，Stage 3 的空间 self-attention 并没有被替换，也没有减少 token 数量 | 未修复 |
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1857:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:1:结论先放前面：**CLIP/DINO/SAM 直接当 backbone、prompt learner、text anchor、SAM 遮挡增强、LVLM 生成语义 token 这条线基本红了**。2024-2026 已经有 CLIP 语义注入 VI-ReID、CLIP selective prompt tuning、LVLM-ReID、LLaVA/MLLM interactive ReID、SAM occlusion augmentation、KPR promptable ReID 等工作在占位。继续“导入 FM 提精度”不建议碰。参考：CSDN/CLIP-VIReID 已做语义桥接与 prompt learner([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05806))，SCING 做 selective cross-modal prompt tuning([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00506))，LVLM-ReID 做 LVLM semantic token([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18111))，LLaVA-ReID/ICL 已做交互式文本 ReID([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.10174))，DPEFormer 已用 SAM 做 realistic occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435))。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1514:experiments/exp322/design.md:26:- **数据流**：anchor crop x（目标 pid=y）→ 从同 batch 不同 ID y'≠y 抠 pose-masked 人体块 → pose-aware 贴到目标人体边缘（制造 **overlap** 非 covering）得污染图 x̃ → 生成 multi-person heatmap（person-0=y, person-1=y'）+ 记录 distractor 真实 pid y' → backbone（可选 attribution gate）→ (a) **不变性锚**：f(x̃) global+part 经 CE/triplet 监督到 y；(b) **反事实对比锚**：triplet(anchor=f(x̃)目标, positive=同 y 另一图, negative=x̃ 内部 distractor pooled 表征)；(c) **exact dedup**（已知 pid + bbox IoU 跳过重叠/同人样本）。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3334:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:14:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot 无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=自由(新监督信号/跨界 import/新训练目标)**。避死区: CLIP-ReID(language 占)/SMPL 几何(我项目多次证负无独特 ReID 信号)/FM-import MLLM-DINO-SD(我项目证负 判别性-互补性张力)/test-time trick。问: 2026 ReID 训练端哪个范式级方向(新监督信号如 video-temporal/attribute/synthetic-label, 或跨界 import 如 face-recognition/3D/retrieval-pretraining 训练范式, 或新训练目标)最有野心 × 4-slot 单卡周级可行 × 真 novelty × 能 actually build? 给 3 候选排序。**不判死, 选去 build + pipeline + 工作量 + 风险 + B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3338:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:15:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3406:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:1752:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_dualbranch.md:17:#3 oracle 验证: 软融合 AIRL+baseline 距离 → mean +1.46(合法 w=0.25)。双分支 = 1 backbone + 2 BNNeck head 内化这个融合: **f_full**(原 head,ID-CE+shared triplet,无 consistency,保 G→A)+ **f_rec**(新 BNNeck,自己 ID-CE + AIRL consistency,服务低清 A→G)。eval 软融合两 head cosine。framing 钉死"observation-limited evidence ceiling + 按 query 像素预算路由证据空间"(避 resolution-adaptive dual-branch 撞车)。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2016:experiments/exp148/claude_review.md:32:这意味着 backbone 在主任务上的有效学习率被缩小为 1/3。如果最终结果不好，**无法区分是"PCVT 思路无效"还是"主损失被稀释太多导致的"**。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2026:experiments/exp148/claude_review.md:138:**部分是。** exp109 证明的是：如果有同 ID 跨图完整 support，matching 大幅提升。PCVT 的 claim 是：通过在单图内构造"伪多 support"训练，让 backbone 对 partial support 更鲁棒。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2027:experiments/exp148/claude_review.md:140:但"让 backbone 更鲁棒"和"真正补全 support"是两个不同的目标。PCVT 走的是前者（robustness training），不是后者（feature completion）。design.md 对此是诚实的。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2134:experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:275:- **与 oracle 矛盾的根因**: airl_gate_oracle 的 +1.46 上界是用**两个独立模型**(baseline + AIRL)的 score fusion 测的; 单模型双分支共享 backbone, 两头无法分化到独立模型那种互补度 → oracle headroom 不可在单模型内实现（与 exp109 identity-conditioned headroom 不可实现同类陷阱）。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2695:experiments/exp322/design.md:11:- **根因诊断（项目自证）**：Occluded-Duke 训练集 person-0 平均 **95.8% 可见**（中位 100%），backbone 从未见过真实多人歧义 → 所有 target-aware 尝试（exp070/076/077/078 heatmap 硬切、exp107/108 retrieval 侧 counterfactual penalty）都在"推理时区分已经混在一起的表征"，而 backbone 表征本身从未被训练成可分——这是它们封顶的根因。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2697:experiments/exp322/design.md:17:一句话：在 batch 内注入**已知身份**的真实人体作为 pose-aware overlap distractor，并用**反事实身份锚定**（图内注入身体作 pair-specific hard negative）直接监督 backbone，能让 backbone 学到对 inter-person identity contamination 的因果归因不变性——这是注入操作本身（KPR-BIPO / exp157d 已有）所**没有**的、由真实 pid 监督带来的净增量。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3257:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3549:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:4116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:3434:experiments/exp322/design.md:17:一句话：在 batch 内注入**已知身份**的真实人体作为 pose-aware overlap distractor，并用**反事实身份锚定**（图内注入身体作 pair-specific hard negative）直接监督 backbone，能让 backbone 学到对 inter-person identity contamination 的因果归因不变性——这是注入操作本身（KPR-BIPO / exp157d 已有）所**没有**的、由真实 pid 监督带来的净增量。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6843:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:15:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6854:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3334:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:14:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot 无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=自由(新监督信号/跨界 import/新训练目标)**。避死区: CLIP-ReID(language 占)/SMPL 几何(我项目多次证负无独特 ReID 信号)/FM-import MLLM-DINO-SD(我项目证负 判别性-互补性张力)/test-time trick。问: 2026 ReID 训练端哪个范式级方向(新监督信号如 video-temporal/attribute/synthetic-label, 或跨界 import 如 face-recognition/3D/retrieval-pretraining 训练范式, 或新训练目标)最有野心 × 4-slot 单卡周级可行 × 真 novelty × 能 actually build? 给 3 候选排序。**不判死, 选去 build + pipeline + 工作量 + 风险 + B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6857:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3851:**Counterfactual Occlusion Data Engine**：用 diffusion/ControlNet 做 ID-consistent pose/view 变体，再用真实 occluder / non-target pedestrian 做可控遮挡干预，生成带精确 mask、body-part visibility、occluder/donor 标签的成对 clean/occluded 数据，训练 backbone 学“目标身份不变、遮挡因子可被抑制”的表示。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7239:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:29:   - **★ student 统计取自"被遮挡子集"（codex High-1 修复，核心机制点）**：PLBOA 把被遮挡 keypoint 的 score 置 0，但 **GCN token 本身不是 0-mask**——keypoint 坐标保留，标准 bilinear 采样仍在被遮挡像素位置采到一个退化但真实的"遮挡特征"（backbone 对 occluder 像素的响应），这正是探针指认、要被拉向 clean 的 domain-shifted token。陷阱：若像旧实现那样用 student score 给 student 矩加权，被遮挡 token（score≈0）几乎不进 batch 统计、拿不到对齐梯度，VCA 退化成"对齐本来就可见的 token"=空转、与目标相反。**修复**：student 矩只在 **被遮挡且 teacher 可见的 keypoint 子集（`s_sc < vis_thr` 且 `t_sc >= vis_thr`）** 上估计，权重用 **teacher score**（student score≈0 不能当权重）。这样被遮挡 student token 真正进入统计并被拉向 clean teacher。`valid_k` 同时要求 teacher 侧和 student-occluded 侧都有足够权重（双 min-count gate，codex Medium-b）。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7246:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7248:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:66:2. student 前向：backbone(PSG) → featmap → GCN 采 17 token → **VCN（可见性条件仿射，zero-init 恒等起步）** → `kp_data['gcn_kp_feats'] (B,17,C)`, `gcn_kp_weights (B,17)`。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7251:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:69:5. 反传**不更新 backbone**：GCN 分支输入是 `featmaps[-1].detach()`（`pose_backbone_model.py:608`），所以 VCA / GCN 分支只更新 **GCN + VCN + skeleton head**，backbone 经此路径拿不到梯度（codex Medium-c）。teacher 不更新（EMA 跟随 student）。注意 PSG / 主 ID·triplet 仍走非 detach 路更新 backbone，但那不是 VCA 的贡献。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8027:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8030:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8031:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8051:experiments/exp229/design.md:16:通过 OA-SD teacher 的 per-keypoint features 作为 distillation target，让平滑的 L2 梯度流过非 detached 的 backbone features 到达 backbone。这给 backbone 提供了直接的、per-keypoint 级别的学习信号，但梯度足够温和不会灾难。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8082:experiments/exp229/claude_review.md:5:**合理性**: 设计合理。核心假设清晰且有理论依据：L2/cosine distillation 的梯度比 SupCon 的 hard-mining 梯度更平滑，因此即使流到 backbone 也不会灾难。与前序实验 (exp210, exp215, exp220) 的对比表格清晰展示了实验变量的差异。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8083:experiments/exp229/claude_review.md:11:**创新性评估**: BT-PKD 不是小调参。它解决的是一个根本性问题（detach 屏障阻止 part 梯度到达 backbone），用一种新的信号类型（cosine distillation vs SupCon）来绕过 BA-PKC 的失败模式。代码修改量不大（~50行），但核心机制有创新。不属于"只改几行配置"的小调参范畴。

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14141:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14143:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14222:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:1730:experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:145:- f_rec 的 consistency **只读 logits_rec/bn_feat_rec**, 梯度回流 **shared backbone + bottleneck_rec**, **f_full 的 BNNeck/classifier 完全不受 consistency 影响**(smoke D4: f_full grad=0)→ 两 head 不是同一空间复制, f_full 留判别性、f_rec 攻低清。
./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14223:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:1734:experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:157:D1 off 无第二 head + baseline dict keys; D1b on+return_dual=False == baseline f_full 特征(max|df|=0); D2 双 head shape/L2-norm/独立(扰 rec 不动 full); D3 f_rec consistency 梯度到 bottleneck_rec+backbone; **D4 f_full 无 consistency 梯度(头分化真)**; D5 两 head 都入优化器且一步都动; D6 软融合 distmat(w=0→full/w=1→rec/中间凸混合); D7 f_rec consistency 输出 finite(extreme logits/zero feats 下, fp32 + nan_to_num finite guard); D8 f_rec ID-CE 接地(梯度到 classifier_rec+backbone); D9 两 BNNeck 吃同一 global_feat(triplet 单份); D10 f_rec head full-LR。+ 全 py_compile 过 + 现有 `smoke_airl.py` 21/21 不破 + 完整训练步集成验证(loss/两 head 梯度/eval 融合 distmat 全 finite)。

     4	Idea: continued-pretrain SOLIDER swin_tiny so the backbone learns "how to form retrievable identity
     5	evidence when a body part is missing". JEPA in LATENT body-part-token space (not pixel):
     6	  teacher (EMA, sees FULL image) -> part tokens T[B,G,C]
     7	  student (sees pose-defined PARTIAL view, some body groups masked) -> part tokens S[B,G,C]
     8	  L_part_jepa: student must PREDICT the dropped-group teacher tokens from the visible context.
     9	  L_visible_anchor: visible-group student tokens stay close to teacher (don't drift).
    10	  L_union: pooled identity token (student) close to teacher full identity token.
    11	
    12	Stage-A intentionally uses ONLY same-image EMA teacher (= codex's 3090 control "is it just OA-SD/PCVT
    13	renamed"). The MAIN novelty (pseudo same-ID support bank T_bank) is Stage-B, added on top once this
    14	skeleton trains stably. Coordinate-system / loss-collapse points are flagged @REVIEW for codex审 diff.
    15	
    16	Run: python psc_jepa_pretrain.py --backbone pretrained/swin_tiny.pth --data data/occluded_duke \

    42	DEV = 'cuda'

    46	# --- COCO-17 keypoints -> 5 body groups (indices) ---
    47	# 0 nose,1-2 eyes,3-4 ears,5-6 shoulders,7-8 elbows,9-10 wrists,11-12 hips,13-14 knees,15-16 ankles
    48	GROUPS = {
    49	    'head':  [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
    50	    'torso': [5, 6, 11, 12],
    51	    'larm':  [5, 7, 9],
    52	    'rarm':  [6, 8, 10],

    58	def load_pose(npz):

    60	    fn = d['filenames']; vis = d['visibility'].astype(np.float32); kp = d['keypoints'].astype(np.float32)
    61	    return {fn[i]: (kp[i], vis[i]) for i in range(len(fn))}                  # name -> (kp[17,2], vis[17])

    64	class PSCDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    65	    """image (384x128 tensor) + per-group visibility mask + per-group featmap-grid region mask."""
    66	    def __init__(self, data, pose):
    67	        self.dir = os.path.join(cli.repo, data, 'bounding_box_train')
    68	        self.pose = load_pose(pose)
    69	        self.items = [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(self.dir)) if f.endswith('.jpg') and f in self.pose]
    70	        if cli.smoke:
    71	            self.items = self.items[:cli.smoke]
    72	        self.mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406]).view(3, 1, 1)
    73	        self.std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225]).view(3, 1, 1)
    74	
    75	    def __len__(self):
    76	        return len(self.items)
    77	
    78	    def _grid_region(self, kp, vis):
    79	        """Per-group: visibility (any kp in group visible) + bbox region mask on GHxGW grid.
    80	        @REVIEW codex: keypoints are pixel coords in the ORIGINAL crop; we read crop size and normalize
    81	        to [0,1] then to grid. If pose npz coords are already resized to 384x128, drop the /w,/h."""
    82	        gvis = np.zeros(G, np.float32); gmask = np.zeros((G, GH, GW), np.float32)
    83	        for gi, gk in enumerate(GKEYS):
    84	            idx = GROUPS[gk]
    85	            v = vis[idx]; pts = kp[idx][v >= cli.vis_thr]
    86	            if len(pts) == 0:
    87	                continue
    88	            gvis[gi] = 1.0
    89	            xs = np.clip((pts[:, 0]) * GW, 0, GW - 1e-3); ys = np.clip((pts[:, 1]) * GH, 0, GH - 1e-3)
    90	            x0, x1 = int(xs.min()), int(xs.max()); y0, y1 = int(ys.min()), int(ys.max())
    91	            gmask[gi, y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = 1.0
    92	        return gvis, gmask
    93	
    94	    def __getitem__(self, i):
    95	        name = self.items[i]
    96	        im = Image.open(os.path.join(self.dir, name)).convert('RGB')
    97	        ow, oh = im.size
    98	        im = im.resize((IMG_W, IMG_H))
    99	        t = torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(im, np.float32).transpose(2, 0, 1) / 255.0)
   100	        t = (t - self.mean) / self.std
   101	        kp, vis = self.pose[name]
   102	        kpn = kp.copy(); kpn[:, 0] /= max(ow, 1); kpn[:, 1] /= max(oh, 1)    # normalize to [0,1]
   103	        gvis, gmask = self._grid_region(kpn, vis)
   104	        return t, torch.from_numpy(gvis), torch.from_numpy(gmask)

   107	def build_backbone():
   108	    from model.backbones.swin_transformer import swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224

   110	                                       attn_drop_rate=0.0, pretrained=os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.backbone),
   111	                                       convert_weights=False, semantic_weight=cli.semantic_weight)  # H2: match downstream 0.2
   112	    net.init_weights(os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.backbone))

   114

   116	def part_pool(featmaps, gmask):
   117	    """featmaps[B,C,Hf,Wf] + gmask[B,G,Hf,Wf] -> part tokens[B,G,C] (masked avg-pool, L2)."""
   118	    B, C, Hf, Wf = featmaps.shape
   119	    if (Hf, Wf) != (GH, GW):
   120	        gmask = F.interpolate(gmask, size=(Hf, Wf), mode='nearest')
   121	    denom = gmask.sum((2, 3)).clamp_min(1.0)                                 # [B,G]
   122	    tok = torch.einsum('bchw,bghw->bgc', featmaps, gmask) / denom.unsqueeze(-1)
   123	    return F.normalize(tok, dim=2)

   125	
   126	def fwd_tokens(net, x, gmask):
   127	    out = net(x)
   128	    featmaps = out[1] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out
   129	    if isinstance(featmaps, (tuple, list)):
   130	        featmaps = featmaps[-1]
   131	    return part_pool(featmaps, gmask)                                        # [B,G,C]

   134	def main():
   135	    ds = PSCDataset(cli.data, cli.pose)
   136	    bs = min(cli.bs, len(ds)) if cli.smoke else cli.bs                      # v2-Med: smoke<bs 不静默空跑
   137	    dl = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=bs, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, drop_last=(not cli.smoke))

   146	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(list(student.parameters()) + list(predictor.parameters()), lr=cli.lr, weight_decay=0.05)
   147	    os.makedirs(os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out), exist_ok=True)

   167	            dmask_grid = (gmask * drop.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1).clamp(0, 1)   # [B,GH,GW]
   168	            dmask_img = F.interpolate(dmask_grid.unsqueeze(1), size=(IMG_H, IMG_W), mode='nearest')
   169	            x_part = x * (1.0 - dmask_img)                                   # zero-out dropped region (post-norm≈mean, ok as occlusion)
   170	            S = fwd_tokens(student, x_part, gmask)                           # [B,G,C]
   171	            Sp = F.normalize(predictor(S.reshape(-1, C)).reshape(B, G, C), dim=2)  # C1: predictor(student) predicts teacher
   172	            # losses (cosine in latent token space, predictor-asymmetric)
   173	            cos = (Sp * T).sum(2)                                          # [B,G] predicted-vs-teacher sim
   174	            drop_m = drop * gvis                                           # only dropped & originally-visible
   175	            vis_m = (1.0 - drop) * gvis                                     # visible & kept
   176	            L_jepa = ((1.0 - cos) * drop_m).sum() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)   # predict dropped from context
   177	            L_anchor = ((1.0 - cos) * vis_m).sum() / vis_m.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
   178	            su = F.normalize(predictor((S * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1)), dim=1)   # union identity token (predicted)
   179	            tu = F.normalize((T * gvis.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1), dim=1)
   180	            L_union = (1.0 - (su * tu).sum(1)).mean()
   181	            vmask = gvis.reshape(-1).bool()                                 # v2-High: only visible-group tokens (drop zero-vectors)
   182	            Svis = S.reshape(-1, C)[vmask]
   183	            std_s = (Svis.std(0) * (C ** 0.5)) if Svis.shape[0] > 1 else torch.ones(C, device=DEV)  # ×√C: healthy≈1, collapse→0
   184	            L_var = F.relu(1.0 - std_s).mean()                              # target 1 now reachable
   185	            loss = cli.w_jepa * L_jepa + cli.w_anchor * L_anchor + cli.w_union * L_union + cli.w_var * L_var
   186	            opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step()
   187	            # EMA teacher update
   188	            with torch.no_grad():
   189	                for ps, pt in zip(student.parameters(), teacher.parameters()):
   190	                    pt.mul_(cli.ema).add_(ps.detach(), alpha=1 - cli.ema)
   191	            last = dict(L=loss.item(), jepa=L_jepa.item(), anchor=L_anchor.item(), union=L_union.item(),
   192	                        var=L_var.item(), tok_std=std_s.mean().item(),       # C1(v2): √C-scaled healthy≈1, <0.5=坍缩警戒
   193	                        cos_drop=(cos * drop_m).sum().item() / drop_m.sum().clamp_min(1).item())
   194	            if it % 50 == 0:
   195	                print(f"  ep{ep} it{it}/{len(dl)} L={last['L']:.4f} jepa={last['jepa']:.4f} anchor={last['anchor']:.4f} "
   196	                      f"union={last['union']:.4f} var={last['var']:.4f} tokStd={last['tok_std']:.3f} cosDrop={last['cos_drop']:.3f}", flush=True)
   197	        print(f"[epoch {ep}] " + " ".join(f"{k}={v:.4f}" for k, v in last.items()), flush=True)
   198	        if (ep + 1) % cli.save_every == 0 or ep == cli.epochs - 1:
   199	            sd = {f"backbone.{k}": v for k, v in student.state_dict().items()}  # H1: backbone. prefix for downstream init_weights
   200	            torch.save({'state_dict': sd}, os.path.join(cli.repo, cli.out, f"pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth"))
   201	            print(f"[save] pscjepa_{ep+1}.pth ({len(sd)} keys, backbone. prefix)", flush=True)
   202	    print("[done] PSC-JEPA stage-A pretrain complete.")
   203	
   204	
   205	if __name__ == '__main__':
   206	    main()

./experiments/decisions.md:5:**上下文**: Phase 1 (33 个实验) 已充分探索了基于 ViTPose visibility 向量的所有方向。最佳训练端改进仅 +1.4%（GiLt+PCFC）。用户指示放弃 visibility 方向，转向纯 pose heatmap + mmpose 更鲁棒模型。
./experiments/decisions.md:9:1. Visibility 向量不够可靠（与 AP 相关性仅 0.237）
./experiments/decisions.md:974:**上下文**: 下一阶段准备把 `visibility` 引入当前的 skeleton branch / keypoint pooling 路线。但当前多人图中仍存在一个更基础的问题：`pose_data` 和 branch 侧并没有稳定地区分“crop 中的目标人”和“旁边靠得很近的其他人”。如果先做 visibility，再去解决 target assignment，visibility 语义会被污染，后续所有结论都不可靠。
./experiments/decisions.md:977:1. `visibility` 是 **target-specific** 语义，不是 scene-level 语义
./experiments/decisions.md:978:2. 只要 target person 还会和邻近人物混淆，`visibility`、`KPP`、`GCN` 都会学脏
./experiments/decisions.md:979:3. 因此必须先解决 **target assignment**，再做 visibility 融合
./experiments/decisions.md:981:**决策**: visibility 路线按 5 个阶段推进，严格顺序执行，不跳步。

./experiments/decisions.md:1103:**关键教训（收紧版）**: 目前只能说 `score*visibility` 在当前 keypoint-level 加权池化中未带来正向证据。Visibility 是否能在其它位置（如 retrieval-time reasoning、pairwise masking、target-aware setting）发挥作用，仍需后续更精确的问题定义来判断。

./experiments/decisions.md:1110:1. 训练集 95.8% keypoint 可见 → 训练时 visibility 几乎没有变化信号
./experiments/decisions.md:1136:### [2026-03-23 02:30] 决策 #N: exp148/149/151 结论与训练集 visibility 关键发现
./experiments/decisions.md:1143:1. **exp148 PCVT**: 早期加速（ep30 +2.4 mAP），后期被基线追平并反超（ep100 -0.9 mAP）。3-view 训练的 1/3 主损失稀释 + 训练数据缺乏 visibility 多样性。
./experiments/decisions.md:1147:**选择**: 彻底放弃所有训练时 visibility-dependent 的创新方向。
./experiments/decisions.md:1150:1. 训练集 95.8% 可见 → 任何依赖训练时 visibility 变化的机制都缺乏信号
./experiments/decisions.md:1154:**后续约束**: 不再在训练侧做任何 visibility-conditioned 机制。如果要改善遮挡鲁棒性，只有两条路：(a) 数据增强缩小 train-test visibility gap (b) 改善 test-time matching。
./experiments/decisions.md:1162:4. **训练集 95.8% 可见**：解释了所有 visibility-dependent 方法的失败。
./experiments/decisions.md:1211:**理由**: LKA 实现更快，完成关键点加权调查线（score→visibility→learnable），无论结果如何都为 AFF 提供信息
./experiments/decisions.md:1225:2. BPBreID / KPR 的 visibility 主要落在 **query-gallery pairwise distance**，不是只改 pooling。
./experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10
./experiments/decisions.md:1594:- Visibility 方向已关闭

./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:1:# 实验 exp328: VC-Norm — 把"遮挡"当 domain factor，对 per-part token 做 visibility-conditioned normalization 对齐
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:11:VC-Norm 的洞察：**把可见性当条件变量，对 per-part token 显式做 visibility-conditioned 归一化，并用一个对齐目标把 occluded 路 token 的"可见性条件归一化统计"拉向 clean 路的统计，从而消掉这条 domain 轴**——但只动归一化统计（per-keypoint per-channel 的 mean/std 漂移），不动可分辨身份的判别方向（关键 caveat：别把对齐做成「抹身份」）。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:21:1. **新模块** `model/modules/vcnorm.py` → `class VisibilityConditionedNorm(nn.Module)`（插件式）。

./experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:24:`kp_w` 来自 `kp_data['kp_weights']`，由 GCN head 根据 `pose_dict` 中的原始 keypoint scores 计算。PLBOA（`_apply_lower_body_occlusion`）**只修改图像像素，不修改 `persons` 数据的 scores**。因此 `kp_w > 0.3` 对所有原始可见 keypoints 都为 True，包括被 PLBOA 遮挡的那些。
./experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:26:**影响**: POI loss 会尝试对齐被遮挡 keypoints 处的特征（clean vs occluded），完全违背了"仅对齐可见部分"的核心设计意图。训练集 95.8% 可见意味着几乎所有 17 个 keypoints 都被标记为 visible，POI 退化为全局特征对齐。
./experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:28:**修复方案**: 需要在 PLBOA 之后更新 pose_dict 中的 visibility/scores，或在 OERL 中根据 PLBOA 的遮挡区域独立计算哪些 keypoints 被遮挡。例如，保存 PLBOA 的 `occ_start` 坐标，将 y > occ_start 的 keypoints 标记为 occluded。

./experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:194:`pooled_feat` 是 5 个 part_feats 的 visibility-weighted 平均。在 loss_fn 中，`score[0]` 是 `global_cls`，`score[1]` 是 `pooled_cls`，`score[2:]` 是 `part_cls`。所以 `pooled_feat` 被 `pooled_classifier` 分类，但它是 part_feats 的加权平均——这意味着 pooled_classifier 和 part_classifiers 看到的是高度相关但不完全相同的特征分布。这不会导致 bug，但增加了一个冗余的 classifier head。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:3028:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4076:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6740:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4171:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:8375:    34	库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4420:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4470:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3851:**Counterfactual Occlusion Data Engine**：用 diffusion/ControlNet 做 ID-consistent pose/view 变体，再用真实 occluder / non-target pedestrian 做可控遮挡干预，生成带精确 mask、body-part visibility、occluder/donor 标签的成对 clean/occluded 数据，训练 backbone 学“目标身份不变、遮挡因子可被抑制”的表示。

./experiments/exp340_swin_lgpa_fixedbands/claude_review.md:56:- **device/缓存**：`_canon_hm_cache` 在 CPU 建一次（`torch.zeros(...)` 默认 CPU），之后每次 `.to(device).expand(...)`。`.to(device)` 对已在该 device 的 tensor 是 no-op（不重复拷贝到同设备），缓存只建一次，正确。注意它是普通属性而非 `register_buffer`，所以 `model.to(device)` / `.half()` 不会动它——但因为每次调用都显式 `.to(device)`，device 始终正确；dtype 恒为 float32，clip_part_head 内 `_compute_pose_bias` / `_compute_gt_assignment` / visibility 都先 `.float()`，与 AMP 下 float16 featmap 的 bias 相加发生在 `_cross_attention_with_pose`：`attn_scores`(来自 featmap，可能 fp16) + `pose_bias.unsqueeze(1)`(fp32) → 触发上采 fp32，再 `clamp(-50,50)` → softmax，无 dtype 崩溃。安全（与 scene 热图路径完全同构，scene 热图本身也是 fp32）。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5371:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:132:H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。
