./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:96:"novel_component": "The \"min-of-pairwise occlusion weights\" matching rule: instead of weighting each part by a single image's visibility, weight it by the minimum of the query's and gallery's part-visibility, so a body part only influences the score when it is co-visible in both images — a symmetric pair-comparability gate that requires no extra training and keeps the always-available global feature at fixed weight 1."
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:117:"mechanism": "Uses a Stable Diffusion virtual-try-on pipeline (LaDi-VTON) to generate cloth-changed copies of each pedestrian with a unified, consistent clothing color/type, so the model can no longer rely on clothing as an ID cue. Generation is controlled by SCHP body-segmentation masks (clothing regions are inpainted while non-clothing body parts are kept fixed) and OpenPose keypoints (to keep the synthesized image faithful to body geometry/pose); two threshold filters (a ReID-feature similarity filter and a batch-wise FID filter) plus manual inspection discard low-quality generations. The filtered augmented set trains a CAL baseline augmented with a centroid loss that tightens intra-ID clusters and pushes apart the centroids of same-vs-different-ID groups, yielding +6 Rank-1 / +4.4 mAP on PRCC cloth-changing.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:158:"transfer_to_occluded": "SAM's confidence-modulated skeletal-region masks are directly an occluded-ReID mechanism and transferable as a drop-in replacement for keypoint-heatmap masks. Two concrete ideas: (1) build soft masks over the inter-keypoint BONE regions (Gaussian radiation along segment AB, narrow/elongated, tunable transverse compression) instead of only at keypoints, covering the appearance area BETWEEN joints that keypoint heatmaps miss — this fills the coverage gap and reduces incomplete-region feature extraction; (2) modulate each region mask's strength by the geometric-mean/sum of its two endpoint keypoint CONFIDENCES (δ_A, δ_B) with a confidence threshold T=0.7, so occluded body parts automatically get near-zero mask response and are softly excluded, giving a continuous visibility signal grounded in pose-estimator uncertainty rather than a hard binary part-visibility flag.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:160:"novel_component": "Closed-form \"Skeletal Area Modeling\": a per-bone 2D Gaussian mask radiated along each keypoint-pair segment, whose amplitude is gated by the product/level of the two endpoint keypoint confidences (with a threshold T). This turns pose-estimator confidence into a smooth, region-level (not point-level) visibility prior over body parts — no trainable params, robust to low-res images where pixel-level parsing masks fail."
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:173:"mechanism": "A ViT extracts a global feature G and N patch embeddings. A two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Dynamic Retrieval (CFDR) routes \"easy\" queries through an early-exit using only G, while \"hard\" queries proceed to a fine stage. The fine stage uses a Part-aware Mixture of Experts (PMoE): a Patch-to-Part Router (PPR), supervised by human-topology coarse body-part labels plus a Push Loss, soft-routes patches to M body-part experts (cross-attention modules) via Probability-Weighted Average Pooling, and binary visibility routing weights activate only body-relevant experts (deactivating occluded parts) to cut computation.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:174:"novel_component": "A label-free, near-zero-cost occlusion/visibility detector: sort the cosine similarities between the global feature G and each patch embedding in descending order, take their first-order differences, and pick the index of the maximum difference as the split point between body patches (high similarity to global identity) and background/occlusion patches (low similarity). This treats body vs occlusion as separable classes in feature space and detects the transition without pose estimation or human parsing.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",
./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:836:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4304:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1042:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4833:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14585:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2296:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15408:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6278:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:2008:遮挡这块也不干净。QPM 已经做 pair-wise common non-occluded regions 和 target attention([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.00107?utm_source=openai))；DPEFormer 做动态 patch selection + SAM occlusion augmentation([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435?utm_source=openai))；OGFR 2025 做 occlusion-guided purification / low-quality token erasing([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.08520?utm_source=openai))；ETNDNet 已经把 non-target pedestrian / obstacle 当噪声扰动处理([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07187?utm_source=openai))。你们历史上 completion、occluder gate、visibility 都撞墙，GOPL 又证明 SMPL overlap 只是 occlusion-count/view-diff 代理。继续做 donor-ID leakage，最多是最后一枪，不是主线。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3881:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4742:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3395:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3884:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4752:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3424:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3952:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_airl.md:17:AIRL = resolution-degradation consistency: ground 图退化到 aerial 像素预算 + 强迫退化版预测==原版 → 学低像素预算下稳定的身份证据。**无 contrastive/late-interaction/pooling/prototype/visibility(避开 OVLI 死区)。** kill-switch #1 PASS(小尺度桶强 Swin 上仍塌 +13~19)后验机制利用。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3968:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:771:experiments/exp360_intruder/design.md:10:| **Intruder Identity Suppression** | **7.0/10 ✅** | 避开 completion/visibility/occluder-gate 死区；novelty 窄缝（KPR/QPM/DPEFormer/OGFR 相邻但无"显式 donor-ID 泄漏可测+训练对抗+测试单图"直接同构） |
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3994:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4010:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1042:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4833:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14585:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4623:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21541:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4626:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21544:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2989:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1830:reassess/r_3.md:4027:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2774:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5297:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:8499:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4742:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3395:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:9640:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8025:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:9730:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9473:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4090:experiments/exp110/design.md:15:用 identity-level prototype bank 把 low-visibility keypoints 蒸馏向更完整的 support teacher。
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:9745:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9508:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4567:experiments/exp111/design.md:5:`exp110` 证明了训练端的 `support-complete prototype distillation` 能在单 seed 上转正，但增益仍然偏弱。当前实现里 `POSE_SCKD_MIN_COUNT=1`，意味着某个 identity 的某个 keypoint 只要出现过一次 high-visibility 观测，就会被当作 teacher 使用。这种 teacher 过于宽松，容易把偶然噪声、姿态抽取误差、遮挡下的不稳定局部都写入 bank。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:9772:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10154:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). ./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10006:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5549:./reassess/r_2.md:1263:reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10017:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10058:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3713:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5953:./reassess/r_3.md:8374:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10257:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4526:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10339:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1098:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10343:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10462:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8025:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10466:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8029:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10530:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10154:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10563:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11839:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10713:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13450:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",

Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:203:- **pose-part + 只匹配互见部位：最成熟的轴**。PVPM (CVPR'20) 已有 visibility predictor + 只匹配可见部位；KPR (ECCV'24, SOLIDER/Swin) 是当前最强同款。我们的差异仅 **MaxSim**（ColBERT late-interaction 借来）替代固定 part-to-part 对齐——mechanism 小 delta，不是新问题定义。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:207:1. **真新机制**：LoRA↔visibility **交互**（pose/visibility-conditioned LoRA，或 per-part low-rank experts 按遮挡 gate），带消融证明——不是"加了 LoRA 加了 parts"。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:289:- **SAM/SAM2 遮挡 mask**：落入禁止清单 visibility 变体 + KPR 已 human parsing → 增量，不做。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:317:(b) 若要做方法，必须走 **LoRA↔visibility 机制重组** 或 **common-visible-support/reliability 问题 reframe**（CLAUDE.md 钦定方向），不在这条曲线上继续。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:334:- **下一步不是再开 DINO-curve 实验**（CLAUDE.md 铁律：不刷点不堆模块），而是：转 analysis 故事整理，或设计 LoRA↔visibility 机制重组 / common-visible-support·reliability 问题 reframe（CLAUDE.md 钦定方向，需先写设计+红蓝队）。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:389:**唯一幸存 PartNC(Part-level Noisy-Correspondence)**：用部位粒度 image-text 相似度估每个身体部位 clean/noisy 置信(RDE 的 CCD 从 pair 级下沉到部位级)；**真正空白=用 pose-visibility 先验区分"相似度低=遮挡(结构化)"vs"=标注错(随机)"**(RDE/DURA/GA-DMS 把 noise 当随机，表达不出)。复用我们 part-MaxSim 逻辑(einsum bkc,gpc->bgkp .max)+pose 可见性积累。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:424:**砍掉(早借/已死, 负面先验)**：LGPA(text 解耦已建)/FSDC(补全已建+撞墙)/LTCS-LPCS(common-support 判死)/MLS-uncertainty(PartNC 刚死)/adaptive-margin(贴 visibility 证伪)/PACI(sub-center 已建)/conformal(test-time 禁)/counterfactual-attention(PGMA 已有)。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。
./experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:476:- 范式调研同时**否证一批**: gait occlusion-type/residual=已关; CC-ReID 因果换衣=无遮挡 analog 不撞 disentangle; vehicle VANet 两度量=common-support 已死; set/video quality-pool=visibility 已关。诚实负面收窄空间。
./experiments/exp235/design.md:8:- Visibility weighting: 降低遮挡部位权重 → 信息丢失
./experiments/exp235/design.md:18:- Pose-derived visibility mask: M (48-dim binary, 1=visible, 0=occluded)

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1780:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5549:./reassess/r_2.md:1263:reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2031:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4097:./reassess/r_3.md:2314:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:1:结论先说：我会把主线从“怎么对齐航拍-地面”转成“训练标签里的同一身份关系并不等价”。SMPL 不再当身份特征，也不再做 canonical/visibility 对齐，而是当 **可测的几何条件变量**，用来重排训练关系或做因果干预。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2032:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4098:./reassess/r_3.md:2336:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:62:先做方向 1。它最贴合当前失败链：不救 avg/MaxSim，不碰 visibility 红海，不再把 SMPL 当身份特征，而且 kill-switch 足够干净。方向 2 作为备选，只有在 surface ACE 非常集中时再推进，否则容易被审稿人归类为“又一个人体区域遮挡增强”。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2199:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4267:./reassess/r_3.md:3432:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2811:cheap kill-switch：先做纯评测级首验。提取全局特征和按 SMPL 区域聚合的局部特征，对每个 query-gallery 对取可见区域 soft-min 距离或 visibility-penalized 距离。若不训练都没有稳定改善，说明“最优几何距离”信号弱，不继续写复杂损失。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2289:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4358:./reassess/r_3.md:4017:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2700:cheap kill-switch：先做训练很轻的辅助头。冻结或半冻结 SOLIDER，在现有数据上预测 SMPL joint visibility、身体表面区域或姿态几何 token，看辅助监督是否能改善跨视角检索。若只学几何 token 不改善，说明几何语义没有进入身份判别，及时停。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2853:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1694:reassess/r_3.md:3743:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2864:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1705:reassess/r_3.md:3755:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3247:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3102:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4153:reassess/r_2.md:993:reassess/r_3.md:1951:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3147:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4199:reassess/r_2.md:1142:reassess/r_3.md:2336:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:62:先做方向 1。它最贴合当前失败链：不救 avg/MaxSim，不碰 visibility 红海，不再把 SMPL 当身份特征，而且 kill-switch 足够干净。方向 2 作为备选，只有在 surface ACE 非常集中时再推进，否则容易被审稿人归类为“又一个人体区域遮挡增强”。

./experiments/paper_notes/paper_12_ISP.md:301:- 训练时: 用 visibility 对部件 triplet loss 进行掩码（不可见部件不参与 triplet 计算）

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:5122:./experiments/exp111/design.md:5:`exp110` 证明了训练端的 `support-complete prototype distillation` 能在单 seed 上转正，但增益仍然偏弱。当前实现里 `POSE_SCKD_MIN_COUNT=1`，意味着某个 identity 的某个 keypoint 只要出现过一次 high-visibility 观测，就会被当作 teacher 使用。这种 teacher 过于宽松，容易把偶然噪声、姿态抽取误差、遮挡下的不稳定局部都写入 bank。

./experiments/paper_notes/paper_01_KPR.md:48:  - 若 visibility 是二值，query / gallery 只在共同可见 part 上取均值距离
./experiments/paper_notes/paper_01_KPR.md:49:  - 若 visibility 是连续值，使用 `sqrt(v_q * v_g)` 作为 pair-specific 权重

./experiments/exp323/sub_paion MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17934:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4406:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17999:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4650:./reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18004:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4656:./reassess/r_3.md:8010:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18024:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4728:./reassess/r_3.md:8434:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4550:**上下文**: 验证 VC-Norm(occlusion-as-domain-factor, visibility-conditioned normalization) 跨域创新的**前提**——遮挡是否在 per-part-token 的 normalization statistic(mean/var) 上造成可分离分布 shift。若 KL≈0 则无燃料 kill。lab-3090-d 无训练 probe。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18810:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_12.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_13.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/novelty_gopl.txt:11:| (d) pose / visibility / co-visibility-aware ReID | 高风险局部撞车 | [VPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.00537) 已经按 shared visible regions 比较两图；[PVPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230) 用 positive pairs 的 part correspondence + graph matching 自挖 visibility；[QPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.00107) 明确做 pair-wise common non-occluded regions；[High-Order Relation/Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.08177) 用 pose landmarks、图关系、对齐处理 occluded ReID。 | 这是最危险撞车区。GOPL 必须避开“共同可见部位匹配/对齐”叙事，改讲 **训练监督关系重定义**：SMPL overlap 不进入身份表征、不做 inference matching、不做 part alignment，只决定 same-ID positive edge 的可靠性、采样顺序和约束强度。 | 9/10 |

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1152:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens3_import.md:4244:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5917:reassess/r_3.md:8359:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_7.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:3773:./pivot/novelty_gopl.md:16:用联网**尽力查确切先例+撞车**, 逐类判它们是否已做'用几何共同可见表面定same-ID正边可信度并据此重排训练关系': (a)hard-positive mining / sample re-weighting / positive reliability ReID; (b)noisy-correspondence / noisy-label ReID(positive不可靠); (c)curriculum/self-paced ReID(by difficulty); (d)pose/visibility/co-visibility-aware ReID; (e)SMPL/3D-geometry-guided ReID; (f)graph-sampler / relation ReID; (g)metric learning 里'positive不等价'(supcon变体/soft-positive)。撞了说清撞哪+杀伤; 没撞说清切开点。务实中文, verdict(撞车/存活)+证据链接+信心1-10。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4475:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1152:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5767:./reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5818:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5834:./reassess/r_3.md:4728:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:207:1. **真新机制**：LoRA↔visibility **交互**（pose/visibility-conditioned LoRA，或 per-part low-rank experts 按遮挡 gate），带消融证明——不是"加了 LoRA 加了 parts"。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5839:./reassess/r_3.md:4768:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5940:./reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5953:./reassess/r_3.md:8374:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:6:重定义：大家以为 ReID 输入是“一个人图像”，其实应先判断它是不是“证据充分的身份查询”。新问题不是 occlusion/visibility，而是 **observable identity evidence sufficiency**：这张 crop 里有多少可区分、可跨相机复现的局部证据。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_14.txt:25:机制草案：SAM/pose/DINO 生成 bbox 内 candidate masks/keypoints；SOLIDER 对每个候选 mask/crop 提特征。训练用 MIL/EM：正样本对选择最一致的 candidate pair，负样本要求所有 candidate 都远；加 center/area/detector prior，但不依赖人工 prompt。推理时普通单人 crop 退化为 baseline，多人 crop 做 set-to-set matching。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_15.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_11.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3044:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4406:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. ./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3919:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1976:reassess/r_3.md:4631:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:24:`kp_w` 来自 `kp_data['kp_weights']`，由 GCN head 根据 `pose_dict` 中的原始 keypoint scores 计算。PLBOA（`_apply_lower_body_occlusion`）**只修改图像像素，不修改 `persons` 数据的 scores**。因此 `kp_w > 0.3` 对所有原始可见 keypoints 都为 True，包括被 PLBOA 遮挡的那些。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4032:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:92:机制草案：SAM/pose/DINO 生成 bbox 内 candidate masks/keypoints；SOLIDER 对每个候选 mask/crop 提特征。训练用 MIL/EM：正样本对选择最一致的 candidate pair，负样本要求所有 candidate 都远；加 center/area/detector prior，但不依赖人工 prompt。推理时普通单人 crop 退化为 baseline，多人 crop 做 set-to-set matching。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4251:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4618:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review_v2.md:20:v2 完全重写：不再依赖外部遮挡。使用 `torch.randperm` 随机选择 keypoints 作为 `occ_mask`(line 899-902)，然后 `visible = (~occ_mask) & (kp_scores > 0.3)` (line 923) 正确排除了被遮挡的 keypoints。遮挡是自生成的，不依赖 PLBOA。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2180:./validate/v_2.md:5106:./reviews/deep_25.md:14065:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:6065:pivot/p_2.md:2994:./validate/v_3.md:14837:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7037:./validate/v_3.md:2419:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3591:experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1761:- 为什么新颖: **从未在 person ReID 中使用过**。现有方法要么 concat 所有 part 为一个向量，要么做 pair-wise visible matching。MaxSim 天然处理遮挡（缺失 part 贡献低）且不需要显式的 visibility 估计

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8243:联网边界很清楚：AGPReID 近作已经覆盖了 view decoupling、prompt/local refinement、view-aware semantic experts、TPS 几何 warping、visibility masks；CC-ReID 里也已有 2D-3D surface shape embedding、skeleton-only dynamics、causal clothing shortcut。可用空间要切到“几何作为因果/训练组织变量”，不能再卖“几何特征更好”。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8512:结论先说：我会把主线从“怎么对齐航拍-地面”转成“训练标签里的同一身份关系并不等价”。SMPL 不再当身份特征，也不再做 canonical/visibility 对齐，而是当 **可测的几何条件变量**，用来重排训练关系或做因果干预。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8514:联网撞车边界也很明确：VDT 已做 view-related/view-unrelated 解耦和 CARGO AGPReID 框架，GSAlign 已占 TPS 几何变形 + visibility-aware mask，SeCap/ViSA 已占 prompt、local refinement、view-aware semantic expert 这条线；CSCL 已把 2D-3D correspondence 当 shape embedding 做 CC-ReID；CCIL 已把衣服捷径写成 causal intervention。所以不能再卖“SMPL 几何更准/更对齐/更可见”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8531:这不是 visibility，也不是 alignment；SMPL 只定义“这个正样本监督有多可信”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8544:VDT 是 view 解耦，不处理 same-ID 正边可信度；GSAlign 是几何/语义对齐和 visibility mask；SeCap/ViSA 是 prompt/local semantic alignment；CSCL 是把 2D-3D correspondence 做 shape embedding。GOPL 的切口是“训练关系组织错了”，SMPL 是 pair reliability meter，不是身份特征或对齐模块。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8573:先做方向 1。它最贴合当前失败链：不救 avg/MaxSim，不碰 visibility 红海，不再把 SMPL 当身份特征，而且 kill-switch 足够干净。方向 2 作为备选，只有在 surface ACE 非常集中时再推进，否则容易被审稿人归类为“又一个人体区域遮挡增强”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8576:结论先说：我会把主线从“怎么对齐航拍-地面”转成“训练标签里的同一身份关系并不等价”。SMPL 不再当身份特征，也不再做 canonical/visibility 对齐，而是当 **可测的几何条件变量**，用来重排训练关系或做因果干预。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8578:联网撞车边界也很明确：VDT 已做 view-related/view-unrelated 解耦和 CARGO AGPReID 框架，GSAlign 已占 TPS 几何变形 + visibility-aware mask，SeCap/ViSA 已占 prompt、local refinement、view-aware semantic expert 这条线；CSCL 已把 2D-3D correspondence 当 shape embedding 做 CC-ReID；CCIL 已把衣服捷径写成 causal intervention。所以不能再卖“SMPL 几何更准/更对齐/更可见”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8595:这不是 visibility，也不是 alignment；SMPL 只定义“这个正样本监督有多可信”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8608:VDT 是 view 解耦，不处理 same-ID 正边可信度；GSAlign 是几何/语义对齐和 visibility mask；SeCap/ViSA 是 prompt/local semantic alignment；CSCL 是把 2D-3D correspondence 做 shape embedding。GOPL 的切口是“训练关系组织错了”，SMPL 是 pair reliability meter，不是身份特征或对齐模块。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4406:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4650:./reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4656:./reassess/r_3.md:8010:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4728:./reassess/r_3.md:8434:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4550:**上下文**: 验证 VC-Norm(occlusion-as-domain-factor, visibility-conditioned normalization) 跨域创新的**前提**——遮挡是否在 per-part-token 的 normalization statistic(mean/var) 上造成可分离分布 shift。若 KL≈0 则无燃料 kill。lab-3090-d 无训练 probe。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_3.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3534:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5252:reassess/r_3.md:3743:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3539:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5257:reassess/r_3.md:3755:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3247:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3566:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5336:reassess/r_3.md:4017:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2700:cheap kill-switch：先做训练很轻的辅助头。冻结或半冻结 SOLIDER，在现有数据上预测 SMPL joint visibility、身体表面区域或姿态几何 token，看辅助监督是否能改善跨视角检索。若只学几何 token 不改善，说明几何语义没有进入身份判别，及时停。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3590:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5426:reassess/r_3.md:4505:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3591:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5433:reassess/r_3.md:4542:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3607:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5527:reassess/r_3.md:5069:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:1159:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3631:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5623:reassess/r_3.md:6128:./reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:1697:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4304:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
